style: Romanesque architecture, Leaning Tower of Pisa
similarityReview: The model accurately captures the cylindrical tiered structure of the Leaning Tower of Pisa. The base, the six middle colonnaded levels, and the top bell chamber are represented using stacked cylinders and frustum_pyramids. The tilt is represented by the overall orientation, and the architectural details (arches, columns) are modeled as distinct, slightly protruding parts to ensure visual depth and avoid Z-fighting. The color palette adheres to the requested 7-zone system.
